en: A black‑and‑white view of a village street with leafless trees in the foreground and a row of brick-and-plaster houses behind a wooden picket fence. Two bicycles lean against the fence near the left side. The central building has tall arched windows, decorative brickwork and signage above the doors, suggesting an inn or shop. Handwritten vertical numbers/letters appear along the right border, as on many early photographic postcards.
